commander_identity.mechanical_plan: On Cory's own turn, opponents must have lost actual life before a spell cast FROM HAND gains Abaddon's cascade, and that spell's mana value must fit the greatest life lost this turn. Recurring paid hand casts, reliable all-opponent threshold sources, stacked copies of Abaddon, printed Warhammer cascade, nonhand payoff triggers, and a protected Neheb/Assault combat line define this list.
protected_core: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 — Optimized. Cascade threshold plus paid repeatedly cast Ignus, printed Warhammer multi-cascade, and real protected closing lines can produce decisive turns; do not call it deterministic cEDH or assume unmodeled multiplayer win rates.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Do not trim printed Noise Marine cascade, Nalfeshnee nonhand copies, The Lost and the Damned or the Neheb/Loyal/Assault pivot simply to stuff generic Grixis cards. Warhammer flavor remains a real mechanical choice even where a high-lift card is popular.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: Reconciled all 99 noncommander slots with 62/62 Pass C and earlier Abaddon deep review. Threshold enablers Boltwave, Flame Rift, Loyal, Bowmasters and new Shrine/Mount complement spell-cast pings; Archaelogist/Lost/Nalfeshnee/Noise/Call Forth monetize cascade and exile-cast cards. Keep all three 2MV Talismans and selective rituals, Demonic/Vampiric/Imperial/Gamble/Mystical access, Rhystic/Remora cards, Force/Fierce/Deflecting plus reactive interaction, Wheel/Windfall, Breach/LED/Brain Freeze, Neheb/Assault combat and basic recursion. Stage13 four physically complete five/six/six/seven packages tested the opportunity cost beyond the numeric floor. Selected six compared critically to larger seven and Warhammer alternate six; no automatic candidate ranking.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: 34 lands remain. Mount Doom replaces one of three Mountains, leaving 2 Mountain, 3 Island, 3 Swamp; fetch/typed and rainbow fixing plus all three Talismans preserved. Mount Doom must pay {1}{B}{R} and tap for opponent X3, and costs one life when tapped for black/red. Replacing Ponder sacrifices one-mana smoothing for Sheoldred {2}{B}{B}; commander {2}{U}{B}{R} still requires fixing. Candidate-bound source-count audit and written mana/curve assessment are in Stage18; do not infer measured opening-hand casting probabilities.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Cyclonic Rift, Chaos Warp, Otawara, Deadly Rollick, Blasphemous Act and free/cheap counter-suite survive all six substitutions. Countermagic and Pact can protect setup but Rule of Law blocks cascade hit casts, Drannith Magistrate denies nonhand cascade spells, and graveyard hate blocks Breach; retained Neheb/Assault, Loyal and Mount Doom give nonstorm pressure. Mage 2/2 and offspring 1/1, Sheoldred, Abaddon/Sakashima and Impact invite different interaction vectors. Stage18 documented realistic adverse scenarios and costs.

weakest_slots.reasoning: Tap-and-untap pinger works in pure instant/sorcery turns and gives early each-opponent X3 after surviving summoning sickness; Impact is enchantment immune to ordinary creature sweepers and converts each Ignus/Birgi cast/Spawn ETB into actual all-opponent damage, but is blank when no creatures enter.

weakest_slots.weakness: Ruinous four-mana upkeep can steal opponents' higher-ceiling spell from exile (or hit land)
weakest_slots.reasoning: Ruinous four-mana upkeep can steal opponents' higher-ceiling spell from exile (or hit land); Sanctum two-mana fixed first-main pre-hand X3 only from a prior turn and loses Warhammer opponent-theft flavor.

Same {1}{R} noncreature spell ping; Mage is 2/2 not Kessig 1/3, optional paid Offspring {2} makes a separate 1/1 copy for two X3 triggers per later noncreature cast, and the token makes extra Impact trigger when entering. Kessig toughness survives some one/two-damage removal better and needs no additional mana.

weakest_slots.weakness: Keeper six-mana Warhammer payoff damages on EACH nonhand spell by its mana value, including cascade hits. Sakashima four-mana copying Abaddon adds another independent cascade trigger on qualified hand casts but requires
weakest_slots.reasoning: Keeper six-mana Warhammer payoff damages on EACH nonhand spell by its mana value, including cascade hits. Sakashima four-mana copying Abaddon adds another independent cascade trigger on qualified hand casts but requires Abaddon available during ETB and is weak when the commander is repeatedly removed.

weakest_slots.weakness: Mount Doom enters untapped and replaces basic R with B/R utility, but costs 1 life for color and removes one basic fetch target. Its {1}{B}{R},{T} damage1 to all opponents is an actual reusable payable X3 threshold outsi
weakest_slots.reasoning: Mount Doom enters untapped and replaces basic R with B/R utility, but costs 1 life for color and removes one basic fetch target. Its {1}{B}{R},{T} damage1 to all opponents is an actual reusable payable X3 threshold outside spells and Rule of Law, not mere cosmetic color fixing; high resource cost can make this a lower-priority genuine swap.

weakest_slots.weakness: One-mana top3 selection plus shuffle and draw smooths fragile combo turns and Breach fuel. Exalted (4MV UR) provides repeated random instant/sorcery recursion to HAND and cast pings but requires upkeep
weakest_slots.reasoning: One-mana top3 selection plus shuffle and draw smooths fragile combo turns and Breach fuel. Exalted (4MV UR) provides repeated random instant/sorcery recursion to HAND and cast pings but requires upkeep; Sheoldred (4MV BB) can gain X42 after Wheel at 3 opponents (X84 with Bloodletter) but needs both wheel access and creature survival. Neither is a costless Ponder replacement.

weakest_slots.weakness: Noise printed cascade from an MV5 spell plus ETB Sonic Blaster preserves Warhammer chain without Abaddon on battlefield. Sheoldred gains hand follow-up X ceiling on Wheel but replacing Noise erodes native printed cascade
weakest_slots.reasoning: Noise printed cascade from an MV5 spell plus ETB Sonic Blaster preserves Warhammer chain without Abaddon on battlefield. Sheoldred gains hand follow-up X ceiling on Wheel but replacing Noise erodes native printed cascade and W40K flavor; test of beyond-six opportunity, NOT automatic seventh improvement.

weakest_slots.weakness: A red 1-point noncombat ping becomes 4 under 4/4 Ojer vs 2 under Solphim, but Solphim doubles 4-point Flame Rift to 8, affects nonred damage and remains independent of Ojer power, while Ojer changes red source pings unde
weakest_slots.reasoning: A red 1-point noncombat ping becomes 4 under 4/4 Ojer vs 2 under Solphim, but Solphim doubles 4-point Flame Rift to 8, affects nonred damage and remains independent of Ojer power, while Ojer changes red source pings under four. Both legal 4MV RR; Ojer not universally better.

weakest_slots.weakness: Maintain Stage10 reject: Familiar generates net +{C} per Ignus/Birgi loop and Abaddon 1 generic cost reduction
weakest_slots.reasoning: Maintain Stage10 reject: Familiar generates net +{C} per Ignus/Birgi loop and Abaddon 1 generic cost reduction; Veyran doubles eligible permanent spell triggers but loses that payable resource engine.

weakest_slots.weakness: A narrow blue-spell protection slot can miss nonblue tables or be a dead cascade hit.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain instant interaction and Abaddon turn protection; shroud is sorcery-speed equip-based and trims stack answers.

weakest_slots.weakness: Zero-cost cascade hit can fail without a legal target and delayed upkeep debt punishes a stalled kill.
weakest_slots.reasoning: Retain free stack protection at the decisive combo turn; an equip-based protection artifact would not answer removal/counters on the stack.

weakest_slots.weakness: Call Forth {5}{U}{R}{R} double printed cascade with MV8, hit by Blasphemous Act MV9
weakest_slots.reasoning: Call Forth {5}{U}{R}{R} double printed cascade with MV8, hit by Blasphemous Act MV9; Phoenix MV6 single cascade and grave return when any cascade spell CAST, but needs its own six-mana recast and displaces higher-output existing printed cascade card.

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: The genuinely owner-approved 0d9f… Rev2 already has a six-swap optimized 100-card shell, all 34 lands, Noise/Nalfeshnee, Ignus/Birgi/Familiar, Neheb/Assault/Loyal, strong interaction and tested cascade mechanics. It remains APPROVED and LOCKED; this is a comparative proposal, not retroactive disapproval.
whole_deck_audit.candidate_pool_scope: 16 newly sourced material EDHREC top/high-lift candidates and direct challenges, with Stage4/8/10–12 off-ranking candidates, complete prior 99 audit, three Stage13 alternative full100 packages and a fourth protected six. The owner-selected optimization floor is a presentation minimum, not the search stopping condition.
whole_deck_audit.off_ranked_search_conclusion: OFF-RANKED and unranked missed synergy research covered Sheoldred wheel loss, Sakashima second independent Abaddon cascade triggers, Impact Tremors with Ignus paid ETBs and Lost Spawn entries, Sanctuary pre-main threshold, Mount Doom paid Rule-of-Law independent life loss, as well as Irenicus, Ojer, Bowmasters, Dig Through Time, Treasure Cruise, and costly Assault alternatives. EDHREC 'High Lift' is popularity differential, never proof of a best cut.

final_changes.coherent_package_tradeoff: The six interlocking changes make early each-opponent loss sustainable via Shrine/Mount, increase paid creature-ETB damage via Impact with repeatable Ignus and Offspring, double Abaddon's own-hand cascade trigger ceiling with Sakashima, and add Sheoldred/Wheel as a distinct closing route. The real price is Thermo/Kessig low-mana noncreature ping reliability, Ruinous opponent spell theft, Keeper's nonhand spell-MV damage, one basic land and Ponder's smoothing. Noise Marine, Nalfeshnee, Lost, Call Forth, Neheb/Assault, and critical free protection remain intact; the seventh swap's removal of printed Noise would erode commander identity more than it improves expected quality.

final_candidate.deckwide_reconciliation: The exact new unapproved 100-card physical source has 34 lands and ninety-five distinct nonbasic/basic card names, Abaddon as the single marked commander, only basic repeat quantities 3 Island/2 Mountain/3 Swamp, correct UBR source-bound Oracle color identity and current Commander legality. Six named additions minus six matching current locked Rev2 cuts. Oracle-based logical hash lh1:965f298aa71b9a3f28d805ee99b2d2576913ca8ba78a0824e9aa205cc8133ceb distinct from raw SHA256. CI source-binds full95 Oracle, fourteen newly implemented changed P0 cases, seventy-seven unchanged former core P0 mechanics only conditionally reused, twenty-seven displaced comparator P0 never falsely carried over, Stage18 red-team/mana and scoped four-portfolio I/J. Does not prove multiplayer optimum or M6.10 owner milestone acceptance.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Ponder loss to Sheoldred is real; Noise Marine was explicitly tested as alternate seventh cut and rejected; keeping Nightscape Familiar, Call Forth, Pact and free counters preserves backup engines over padding.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: The approved Rev2 is cohesive but now underuses actual early threshold opportunities from passive Shrine, paid land, Ignus-linked Impact and offspring tokens, stacked independent Abaddon clones, plus Sheoldred/Wheel in the 99. Comparing whole 100 and cuts supports a genuinely more flexible Abaddon-first configuration despite Ponder's loss.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Select six rather than defaulting to the five-swap presentation floor or forcing a seventh. Concrete cut opportunity includes both no-summoning-sickness threshold reliability and increased BB mana pressure; adversarial source-bound mechanics and protected 40K/Neheb engines support a quality-first stop rather than numerically maximizing swaps.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: After reaching five, the entire retained approved Rev2 99 was re-opened: seven land/color groups, all 34 mana sources, 3 Talismans/rituals, interaction/free protection, Ponder vs Sheoldred, actual Warhammer cascade/exile-copy payoffs, 1MV/2MV threshold, secondary Breach line and Neheb/Assault under restrictions. Stage13 physically evaluated an extra Warhammer six and seven replacement stress deck. Retained Noise, Nightscape, Call Forth, Pact, Xander's Lounge, and Solphim were separately challenged; beyond-six changes were rejected for stronger synergistic opportunity cost, not because six was a predetermined quota.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Ojer turns each red one-damage source into four if power4, but Solphim doubles the original four-damage Flame Rift and nonred burn and does not rely on Ojer remaining 4 power. Retain Solphim for the whole 100 even though Ojer is exciting in a different dense-red-pinger build.

Aurora is six-mana flying single printed cascade with grave recurrence if a cascade spell is cast. Call Forth at eight has two printed cascades and amplified original payoff when cast during a large own-turn; removing it dilutes distinctive 40K cascade mass and cannot be offset by theoretical high EDHREC lift alone.

Familiar's reduction generates real payable recurring Ignus/Birgi resources and lowers Abaddon generic costs. Apostle needs summoning readiness plus {3},{T} to grant the next noncreature cascade, with poorer repeatability than protected current engine even when its observed EDHREC high lift is large.

larger_swap_packages.case_for_extra_swaps: The seven-card coherent higher-count configuration retains Sheoldred's conditional Wheel X42 while adding the 40K Exalted Flamer repeated instant/sorcery recursion to hand as a second commander-cascade feed and possible 40K damage trigger.
larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: The tested seventh replaces Noise Marine's printed cascade and immediate Sonic Blaster with delayed four-mana random recursion, sharply lowering unique independent Warhammer cascade pressure. Under Abaddon removal Noise is still a live cascade card, while Exalted's upkeep is delayed and Ponder is already sacrificed. Six is a stronger whole-100 balance.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stop at six because the specific seventh credible card has a net commander-identity and resilience cost: it displaces Noise Marine, an Abaddon-independent printed cascade card, for delayed random recursion; other challenged cuts lose free counters, payable Ignus reduction, actual double cascade, or 34-land colored reliability. This is an authored strongest-realistic-100 judgment after the Stage13 seven-swap source-bound alternative, not a cap imposed by the five-swap threshold or a global win-rate theorem.
